# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| IterativeTDDRunner | src/agents/iterative_tdd_runner.py | Orchestrates the RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop across multiple cycles |
| TDDCycleRunner | src/agents/tdd_cycle_runner.py | Executes one complete RED→GREEN→REFACTOR cycle with retries and learning |
| IncrementalPlanner | src/agents/incremental_planner.py | Determines the next test increment using LLM and existing context |
| PythonLanguagePod | src/agents/python_language_pod.py | LanguagePod implementation for Python TDD: code gen + container execution |
| GoLanguagePod | src/agents/go_language_pod.py | LanguagePod implementation for Go TDD cycles |
| TypeScriptLanguagePod | src/agents/typescript_language_pod.py | LanguagePod for TypeScript TDD via vitest in Podman |
| WorkerAgent | src/agents/worker_agent.py | Generates code for each TDD phase given PodSpec and playbook context |
| TypeScriptWorkerAgent | src/agents/typescript_worker_agent.py | TypeScript-specific code generation agent |
| PodmanOrchestrator | src/agents/podman_orchestrator.py | Stateless sidecar execution layer for containerised test/impl runs |
| PodmanRunner | src/agents/podman_runner.py | Production ContainerRunner backed by rootless Podman |
| EnsembleBuildRunner | src/agents/ensemble_build.py | Drives multi-candidate blind build for one feature in one language |
| PolyglotTDDRunner | src/agents/polyglot_tdd_runner.py | Orchestrates TDD across multiple LanguagePods with efficiency comparison |
| PlaybookManager | src/playbook/manager.py | Core playbook operations: create, update, merge, retrieve, delta apply |
| BulletRetriever | src/playbook/retrieval.py | Hybrid retrieval system for selecting relevant bullets by query |
| PostgresBulletRetriever | src/playbook/postgres_retriever.py | PostgreSQL-backed retrieval using pgvector |
| ContextGraphRetriever | src/retrieval/cgr3_retriever.py | CGR³ Context Graph Retrieve-Rank-Reason pipeline |
| ContextScorer | src/retrieval/context_scorer.py | Scores bullets against request context across temporal, team, tech dimensions |
| InstitutionalKnowledgeService | src/retrieval/service.py | Central knowledge retrieval service for code generation guidance |
| Generator | src/core/generator/module.py | Executes tasks using playbook-guided LLM with bullet retrieval |
| Reflector | src/core/reflector/module.py | Analyses task outcomes, extracts error patterns and learning insights |
| Curator | src/core/curator/module.py | Synthesises reflector insights into actionable playbook delta bullets |
| AdaptiveBroker | src/broker/adaptive_broker.py | Routes tasks to best agent based on historical performance metrics |
| PerformanceAggregator | src/broker/performance_aggregator.py | Extracts and aggregates agent performance metrics from audit trail |
| BrokerAdvisor | src/broker/advisor.py | Recommends agents by capability fit from the capability registry |
| CapabilityRegistry | src/broker/capability_registry.py | Anonymous agent capability tracking and search |
| ModelAttributionTracker | src/benchmark/model_attribution.py | Tracks OpenRouter model attribution in performance metrics |
| ExperimentLogger | src/storage/experiment_logger.py | Unified logger for TDD/ML experiments with PostgreSQL/SQLite fallback |
| PlaybookRepository | src/storage/repository.py | PostgreSQL repository with pgvector for semantic search |
| AuditStore | src/audit/store.py | Append-only event store with hash chain integrity |
| LLMClient | src/utils/llm_client.py | Unified LLM client supporting multiple providers (OpenRouter, Ollama, etc.) |
| BlindEvaluator | src/benchmark/blind_evaluation.py | Scores outputs without knowing which agent produced them |
| ConsensusBuilder | src/ensemble/consensus.py | Builds consensus from multiple model proposals via clustering |
| TDDRunHandle | src/cli/factory.py | Owns sandbox container lifecycle for one `ace tdd` invocation |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Main as main()
    participant ITR as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant TCR as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant WA as WorkerAgent
    participant PO as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant PM as PlaybookManager
    participant EL as ExperimentLogger
    participant Refl as Reflector
    participant Cur as Curator

    Main->>ITR: run_from_feature(feature_path)
    activate ITR
    loop over cycles
        ITR->>Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle)
        activate Planner
        Planner-->>ITR: TestIncrement (spec)
        deactivate Planner
        ITR->>TCR: run(spec)
        activate TCR
        Note over TCR: RED phase (may retry on parse error)
        TCR->>Pod: run_red(spec)
        activate Pod
        Pod->>WA: generate_test(spec, existing)
        activate WA
        WA-->>Pod: test_code
        deactivate WA
        Pod->>PO: pulse({test_file: code, impl_file: existing})
        activate PO
        PO-->>Pod: PhaseResult(red)
        deactivate PO
        Pod-->>TCR: red_result
        deactivate Pod
        alt abort or never pulsed
            TCR-->>ITR: cycle_result (error)
        else RED passed correctly
            Note over TCR: GREEN phase (retry up to max_attempts)
            loop green attempts
                TCR->>Pod: run_green(spec with error_feedback)
                activate Pod
                Pod->>WA: generate_implementation(spec)
                activate WA
                WA-->>Pod: impl_code
                deactivate WA
                Pod->>PO: pulse({test_file, impl_file})
                activate PO
                PO-->>Pod: PhaseResult(green)
                deactivate PO
                Pod-->>TCR: green_result
                deactivate Pod
                alt green passed or abort
                    break
                else
                    TCR->>TCR: update error_feedback
                end
            end
            alt green passed
                TCR->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
                activate Pod
                Pod->>WA: generate_refactor(spec)
                activate WA
                WA-->>Pod: refactored_code
                deactivate WA
                Pod->>PO: pulse({test_file, refactored})
                activate PO
                PO-->>Pod: PhaseResult(refactor)
                deactivate PO
                Pod-->>TCR: refactor_result
                deactivate Pod
                Note over TCR: Learning loop (Reflector+Curator)
                alt learning enabled
                    TCR->>Refl: reflect(task, gen_output, env_feedback)
                    activate Refl
                    Refl-->>TCR: ReflectorOutput
                    deactivate Refl
                    TCR->>Cur: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id, context)
                    activate Cur
                    Cur->>PM: apply_delta(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
                    activate PM
                    PM-->>Cur: added_bullets
                    deactivate PM
                    Cur-->>TCR: curator_output
                    deactivate Cur
                end
                TCR->>EL: log_tdd_cycle(...)
                activate EL
                EL-->>TCR: logged
                deactivate EL
                TCR-->>ITR: cycle_result (success)
            else green failed
                TCR->>EL: log_tdd_cycle(...)
                EL-->>TCR: logged
                TCR-->>ITR: cycle_result (fail)
            end
        end
        deactivate TCR
        alt planner says COMPLETE
            Note over ITR: exit loop
        end
    end
    ITR-->>Main: IterativeResult
    deactivate ITR
```
